list.label: Agents
list.emptyBody: An agent is a role definition that a team uses as a node.

arrange.roleDistinct: Every value is different, so it can't be grouped

pick.title: Select an agent or create one
pick.body: Pick an agent in the list to see its settings and where it's used.

identity.title: Identity
identity.name: Name
identity.descriptionHint: Used as the default for “when to hand work to this agent” when another agent delegates.

display.title: Display (advanced)
display.iconHint: 1–2 characters (emoji allowed) shown on chat replies, team graph nodes, and run screens. Leave empty to use the first letter of the name.
display.iconInvalid: Use 1–2 characters. This value is ignored and the first letter of the name is shown.
display.colorHint: Pick one, or type a CSS color such as #rrggbb. Leave empty to use the color derived from the name.
display.colorInvalid: Unknown color. This value is ignored and the default color is shown.

settings.title: Settings
settings.hint: Gray values are inherited from the common settings. Changing a value sets it for this agent only.
settings.effectiveFailed: Couldn't load inherited values. You can still edit the values you set.

resources.footer: In a team, team-wide resources and resources attached at the node are added on top of these.
resources.commonFailed: Couldn't load the common settings' resources

usages.empty: No team uses this agent yet.

delete.usedNote: If you delete it, the matching nodes in these teams are left as “unknown agent”.
